profile.summary: A company that sells software and services to organizations, including a property risk management software product and special education software and services for K-12 school districts. It does business as Go Solutions. It is owned by Volaris Group, part of Constellation Software.

sources.title: Volaris Group, through its AssetWorks Risk Management business, has acquired the assets of CSA Consulting

review.notes: The Go Solutions terms page names the legal entity 'AssetWorks Risk Management Inc. dba Go Solutions' at 400 Holiday Drive, Pittsburgh, PA, with phone 800-260-2544, matching the agenda name and city. The Volaris page confirms the Volaris Group / Constellation Software ownership and the K-12 special education business. The property risk software claim rests on the Centurisk site's 'AssetWorks Risk Solutions' footer link and is a mild inference, though consistent with the Risk Management Department contract.
